Beside the pretty gorgeous graphics theres not much to see or do. The gameplay itself is repetitive and gets stale very quickly. The whole enviroment is done well but looses its beauty due to questmarkers on every task you do, telling you always where to go and making exploring redundant.

Rather play AC Blackflag instead.
